show: Low Limit Cash Games Poker Podcast
titel: Let Me Review Your Poker Hands

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (Adresse traegt eine session_id, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Launching a new podcast dedicated exclusively to reviewing low-stakes poker hands.
kurzfassung: The host is launching a second podcast dedicated entirely to analyzing listener-submitted poker hands. Listeners can send their hand histories via Instagram for deep dives focused on low-stakes games. The show relies entirely on community submissions to break down leaks, strategies, and correct thinking.
stichpunkte: Launching a new poker hands review podcast focusing on low-stakes games
Submissions must be sent via direct message on Instagram
Required hand details include stakes, effective stacks, and action per street
Focus area is restricted to 1-2, 1-3, and 2-5 no-limit cash games
Goal is to identify player leaks, flawed assumptions, and strategic strengths
Followers are expected to follow the Instagram account before submitting hands

clips.hook: Knowing the final outcome isn't necessary
clips.text: Whether the player won or lost the hand does not matter for the analytical breakdown.
The host expresses high confidence in beating 1-2, 1-3, and 2-5 cash games.

clips.hook: The value of community hand reviews
clips.text: Discord members and paid tier participants benefit greatly from having an experienced player evaluate their play.

clips.hook: No time for garbled hand histories
clips.text: Messy and unorganized submissions will be ignored to save time.

clips.hook: The basic rule for submitting hands
clips.text: Failing to follow the Instagram account before asking for free advice is considered impolite.
